name: Declan O'Malley
bio: Declan O'Malley's journey in motorsport began, unusually, with a fascination for wind turbines on the rugged Irish coastline. This led to a degree in aeronautical engineering from Trinity College, Dublin, followed by a decade honing his skills in the aerospace industry. A chance encounter with a Formula 3 team owner at a local pub sparked a career change, and Declan never looked back. He brings a pragmatic but innovative approach to aerodynamics, always seeking marginal gains through meticulous data analysis and creative problem-solving. He is known for his ability to translate complex engineering concepts into easily understandable terms for the trackside engineers, fostering a collaborative and efficient working environment.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: A wiry man with a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches.
Drinks copious amounts of strong Irish tea.
Has a habit of muttering equations under his breath during races.
